versions.changelog:
- Initial release of thundarr-browser skill metadata with the addition of the _meta.json file.
- No changes to skill features or documentation content.

thundarr-browser 1.0.0

- Initial release of the Agent Browser Skill.
- Enables Thundarr to navigate the web and extract text-based content from URLs.
- Includes a Python engine (browse.py) that summarizes and returns up to 2000 characters of page content.
- Designed for basic web pages; does not support JavaScript-heavy sites yet.
- Useful for fetching real-time data, documentation, and news summaries.
